title: Site and map palettes plus settled-outcome log: actual distinctions and conditional shared joins

reviews.classification: full site/map/history proposal review; claims, custody, local functions and observed knowledge separated
reviews.disposition:
F1: Actual full review covers all259 original lines: L1–L5/T1–T5/M1–M5/C1–C5, WV1–WV8, MP1–MP7 and SI1–SI10 plus disposition/checks. The examples are original proposals, not newly source-qualified canon, real hidden truths or implemented sites. Current SR1–SR24 and current PROJECT/AD33/AD49/AD51 govern selected work; the October16 blanket layout deferral and1366 browser sentence are historical, not a fresh veto or today's desktop target. No underlying source, map runtime, site image or generated layout was inspected.

F2: Retain distinct useful functions: an archive preserves/locates/interprets actual records; a temple's building/history/practice/ritual differ; a mine's source/access/exposed stock/extraction/processing/custody differ; a natural cave need not have a civilization, chest or enemy. Repairing an index exposes indexed records, not every hidden subject; restoring a room need not restore issuing authority or magic. A supported reconstruction can recover missing text, but conjecture stays labelled. Authenticity/age/value is not accuracy. Adjacent mine/cave labels must not duplicate the deposit or site.

F3: Restoration selects stabilization, preservation, useful access, apparatus, repurposing or habitat goals. It need not erase later layers or impose full pristine restoration, clergy, law, geology, fluid/air physics or workforce simulation. Real strong means may repair/change more when source-supported under AD38; the ordinary bounded example is not a power ceiling. Local material identity/condition/external support remain separate; no genre-created hunger, collapse or disease penalty. New deposits and renewal need actual cause, not reload or return. One sampled batch does not certify all reserves or remaining value.

F4: MP1–MP7 preserve actual work/edition/copy or device entitlement, source lineage/date/world/era/coverage/frame and claims. Buy/borrow/copy/inherit/survey are different supported routes. Paying transfers the actual entitlement once; readable directions can support a first visit without prior visit or a ceremonial study click. No unsupported passage, ownership, universal secret reveal or learned mastery follows. Real survey commitments bind their prior site/observation before sale, while uncommitted detail can remain lazy; counterfeit claims need not be true. Do not make authenticity contingent on the buyer's later inventory or leak hidden potency in price/sort/counts. Corrections retain original claim/provenance; copies of one survey are not independent corroboration.

F5: SI joins keep original versus dated update, observation versus interpretation, work versus removed/installed stock, knowledge versus custody and local service versus portable object separate. Losing a map need not erase learned knowledge; live navigation can require its actual device. An illustrated/embodied/supernatural text may grant more through its real mechanism, not a rigid reading taxonomy. Source fixtures, doc checks, runtime tests, browser behavior and optional human discovery judgment are different evidence. Future purchase/return/persistence cases are proposed distinguishing checks, not newly passed tests or universal prerequisites. No map purchase, acquisition, site implementation, migration, worker, deletion, commit or push.

reviews.classification: full site/map/history proposal review; claims, custody, local functions and observed knowledge separated
reviews.disposition:
F1: Actual full review covers all179 original lines: P1–P5, WT1–WT8, DT1–DT7, UT1–UT6, ST1–ST14, SC1–SC4 and all boundaries. The world palette is optional original design and no named franchise landmark/source mechanic is qualified by its genre row. Current SR rules/PROJECT/AD33 govern selected procedures; NPC-heavy work and layouts retain later user changes at their actual scopes, not the old all-deferred statement. Current UI owners supersede the1366 target. No world, source pass, implementation or active queue is selected here.

F2: Preserve distinct world laws beyond renamed nouns: technological apparatus/energy, living substrate, dream relation and temporal continuity can interact without enabling their whole family. Original/frontier examples do not authorize new Frontier depth against current PROJECT. A source-world greenhouse/workroom/cave requires qualified place/era/law, while an original site need not await every novel. Intact/ordinary/peaceful sites remain valid; no mandatory lost civilization, supernatural artifact or fight. Named secrets stay within their discovery route.

F3: Discovery lead/location/entrance/known extent/interpretation/executable use are separate evidence states, but one actual strong action may establish several and no seven-click ritual is required. Deterministic site truth differs from attempted reading/chance and reopening detail is not a new generation draw. Useful output can be material, object, information, measurement, actual function or access; historical prose or a filled bar alone does not demonstrate an engine consumer. Apparatus usefulness while installed differs from portable loot and body/tool compatibility remains local.

F4: ST1–ST14 preserve actual custody/installed components, present habitat/past function, evidence/destructive work, activation/stabilization, intrinsic sample/local support, retreat, containment, provenance, ownership, alternative routes, renewal/clock, directional cross-world use and communicated knowledge. Costs and aftereffects follow real selected mechanisms. Do not negate a working power to protect a puzzle or impose unmodelled ecology/disease/legal penalties. Default first-slice warnings/retreat do not forbid a source-qualified or selected harsh threat under current loss rules. Failure need not erase discoveries or provide universal free undo. SC1–SC4 remain alternatives and meaningful later possibilities, not four compulsory dispatched slices. Save/import/draw/known-return cases remain future scoped evidence; no new runtime or source proof, worker, migration, deletion, commit or push.

reviews.classification: full site/map/history proposal review; claims, custody, local functions and observed knowledge separated
reviews.disposition:
F1: Actual full review covers all107 original lines: BI2.1 committed-receipt schema, BI2.2 publication/idempotency/retention, BI2.3 query/index/coverage contract and every BI2.4 lane mapping P5–P38/craftingCR1–CR4. This is a proposed shared join, not an implemented universal log or adopted event-sourcing rewrite. No SOURCE_AUDIT, P34 store, RETENTION, DUPLICATES, runtime or migration was freshly inspected merely because the proposal links it.

F2: A committed transition can be acceptance/reservation/partial work/refusal/expiry/delivery/completion/cancel/observation; its receipt does not by itself mean final goods/consent/payment. A physical event and later testimony delivery differ; late receipt cannot backdate observer knowledge. Actual applied deltas/immutable consequences are not a second purse/HP/stock owner. Same transaction can have multiple roles without multiple effects. Local clock, append order and cross-clock mapping differ; unknown input is not zero, while true observed zero is valid. Imported background/premise/director material does not earn lived-player credit. Compensation and corrected belief retain their respective histories without a universal replay claim.

F3: Proposed envelope settlement binds actual owners, immutable terms, receipt/idempotency/draw/knowledge and durable publication. It needs selected producer/state/consumer proof, not schema presence. An operation retry differs from a legitimately new recurrence; conflict detection compares immutable operation content, not a loose matching label. Payload retention and exact dedup identity are separate; a digest/Bloom/count cannot recover erased identity or prove negative history. P34 simultaneous payload/key eviction is an attributed historical claim here, not a fresh reproduced defect. No global extra storage requirement, anti-cheat policy or historical backfill is executed.

F4: Derived indexes/cursors/cache snapshots are not new authoritative history; query revision/lens/coverage/snapshot boundaries matter. Admission precedes counts/facets/pagination/search/errors. No matches means no matches in declared complete coverage, not nobody ever did the act. Exact/archived/aggregate/identity-only/unsupported are different retained capabilities; unavailable exact data blocks its dependent operation, not unrelated play. Domain current state still restores from its owner, and visible report text does not establish hidden world truth.

F5: All mapping rows preserve separate domain responsibility: request terms/reservations, claim/account/edition and message custody, current progression/source/body/site/forces/obligation state, sealed truth, editorial marks/telemetry and captions remain in their actual owners. A dialogue utterance or soundtrack/bookmark is not an awarded effect, duplicate pattern matches are not additional deeds, and generic receipt narration is not a new morality/currency balance. Saveable history/claims, causal reference and player knowledge can use the shared join when selected under AD51 without forcing every listed domain to migrate first. Numeric bounds, append-only schema, cache persistence and compaction plans remain proposals. No runtime, query execution, source reading, migration, worker, deletion, commit or push.

folds.heading: ## Site and map palette reconciliation B573
folds.body: The full [site-family/map palette review](gm/dispatch/procgen-2026-10-13/p11/LIBRARIES_TEMPLES_MINES_CAVES_AND_MAPS_2026-10-16.md#content-reconciliation-b573-map-claims-and-useful-site-functions) and [world-site palette review](gm/dispatch/procgen-2026-10-13/p11/WORLD_SITE_PALETTE_2026-10-16.md#content-reconciliation-b573-world-law-discovery-and-restoration) preserve L/T/M/C, WV/WT, MP/SI, P/DT/UT/ST/SC alternatives under SR1–SR24. An archive/index, ritual apparatus, extraction area, cave, source-qualified original function or known first-visit directions can be useful without loot or a whole adjacent simulation. A bought map transfers its actual copy/entitlement and permitted claims, not ownership, passage, verified truth or every room. Real prior survey commitments bind site/provenance before sale; lazy detail cannot choose authenticity after observing a buyer. Corrections/copies preserve their lineage and learned knowledge can survive medium loss. Installed versus salvaged support, present habitat versus old function, material truth versus local conditions and real clocks/renewal stay distinct. Current AD33 records later procedural direction; AD51 permits a justified shared first seam and current desktop UI evidence supersedes these palettes'1366 target. These examples remain proposals, with no new SR code, world selection, source qualification or implementation. Exact selected body/power means may establish multiple discovery steps or remove a chore; no mandatory restoration/search ritual is introduced.
